hospitals.description: K. Hovnanian Children's Hospital is the pediatric arm of Jersey Shore University Medical Center in Neptune, a few minutes inland from Asbury Park and Ocean Grove. It is the main tertiary pediatric referral point for Monmouth and Ocean counties, with a 24 hour pediatric emergency department, a 10 room PICU, a Level III NICU and general pediatric inpatient units. In 2025 the American College of Surgeons verified the campus as a Level I pediatric trauma center, the first in New Jersey, which makes it the shore's destination for seriously injured children. The children's hospital shares the large JSUMC campus on Route 33, which also houses the 2019 HOPE Tower and a busy adult Level I trauma program. For someone living in Asbury Park this is the closest and most acute pediatric employer in the region.

hospitals.description: Unterberg Children's Hospital is the pediatric service of Monmouth Medical Center, a 514 bed RWJBarnabas teaching hospital on a 21 acre campus in Long Branch, about 6 miles north of Asbury Park along the coast. hospitals.careers_notes: System-wide career site renders server-side: the nurse practitioner category returned 86 jobs over 9 pages on a test fetch on 2026-10-19. City filter pattern is /jobs/nurse-practitioner/us-nj-<city>/ and job detail pages are /job/<id>/<slug>/. Applicant accounts sit on pm.healthcaresource.com (HealthcareSource), so treat as custom. Physician and some APP roles also appear at rwjbh.org/careers/physician-careers/career-opportunities/.

hospitals.description: RWJUH Somerset is the Somerville campus of Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital, merged with the New Brunswick flagship in 2014. It is a Magnet hospital. Its maternity service is an Intermediate Community Perinatal Center with a special care nursery, with Bristol-Myers Squibb Children's Hospital about 9 miles away for higher acuity care.

Intermediate Community Perinatal Center with special care nursery
Campus of RWJUH, linked to Bristol-Myers Squibb Children's
